% Caption kept here, deliberately not typeset - the figure carries a
% number only.  To restore it, move the line below into \caption{}.
% The QQ plots $t\mapsto U_{\sigma_1,OC}^{-1}(U_{\sigma_2,OC}(t))$ of standardized residual life $U_{\sigma,OC}\sim(\theta-\hat{\theta}^T_{\sigma,OC})/\sigma\mid\theta>\hat{\theta}^T_{\sigma,OC}$ under a convex (a) and a concave (b) mills ratio. Both distributions begin at zero, since the marginal applicant has no excess quality at either noise level. $G$ is exponential truncated to $[0,1]$ with density proportional to $e^{-\kappa\theta}$, $\kappa=-3$ in (a) and $\kappa=3$ in (b); $F$ standard normal, $\sigma_1=0.02$, $\sigma_2=0.4$, $v^T=1$, $OC=0.4$, $\lambda^T=0.6$.
\caption{QQ Plot: Standardized Residual Life}
\label{fig:qq_resid}
\end{figure}
